## Export all psych350data datasets as SPSS .sav files {.unnumbered}


### Description

Export all psych350data datasets as SPSS .sav files



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>export_all_sav(dir = ".", use_sentinel = TRUE)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="dir">dir</code></td>
<td>
Directory to save all files. Created if it doesn't exist.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="use_sentinel">use_sentinel</code></td>
<td>
Logical. If TRUE, NA -&gt; -99 with SPSS missing value codes.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

Invisibly returns a named list of file paths created.



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
library("psych350data")

export_all_sav(dir = "~/Desktop/spss_files/")



```
